findings.title: A completion received by the unmounted component leaves the new component offering a new write as the same-command replay
findings.trigger: Submit a valid model configuration; while the real HTTP request is in flight, navigate away and remount NativeModelConfiguration. The new instance snapshots the shared pending payload. Then let the original HTTP request complete.
findings.observed: The old instance clears modelConfigurationPending after COMPLETED or STALE_RESPONSE. The new instance still has the old non-null pendingPayload ref and disabled form, because the shared Map does not notify it. The screen shows host revision 1 but still offers Continue Same Configuration. Clicking it sees remembered undefined at line 51, reads the current host revision and submits a new command ID at revision 2.
findings.impact: Ordinary navigation during a slow save defeats the promised same-command recovery: an already completed configuration is written again under a new command identity and revision when the user explicitly requests continuation. It also leaves a stale locked form until that unintended extra write.
findings.requested_change: Make the pending command owner and its terminal transition observable across component lifetimes. A new component must reconcile completion/removal with its displayed pending state; a continue action must never fall through to constructing a new command when its original pending command has already completed. Preserve the original envelope for genuinely pending operations, and add this in-flight navigation/completion counterexample without weakening the shell barrier or accepting caller-supplied status.

original_findings.evidence: Actual DOM whitespace correction succeeds; IPC source-bound invalid request is NOT_SENT and a corrected payload completes.
ACK followed by remount retains the original full envelope and command_id; completion arriving after remount has new finding W05-UI-V2-001.

verified_boundaries: Author manifest and current source/build input verification: 7432/7432, including 972 author receipt entries, validator inputs, binary, module inventory and all seven Git-delta files.
Trusted transport emits NOT_SENT from local pre-POST failure only. After post() is entered it never copies a remote dispatch_state to the IPC control field.

Independent synthetic remote dispatch_state=NOT_SENT is rejected as INVALID_RESPONSE_SCHEMA; the possibly-sent write barrier remains and a changed payload receives COMMAND_PENDING with zero additional HTTP requests.
ACK and uncertain-send lifetimes survive later local preflight refusal and credential unavailability. Full original envelope and command_id are reused for a legitimate replay.
Selected project without a session uses all-null initial scope; active session preserves project/session/CAS/writer epoch; missing writer is refused before HTTP.
Actual DOM project A ACK, switch to B and submit another payload: no B configure reaches HTTP and B remains editable. Return to A replays the original envelope and completes.

The renderer cache is in-memory and contains the five public ConfigurePayload fields and corresponding form fields; no bearer, credential value or host secret is read into it. IPC retained headers omit Authorization.

existing_limitations_not_new_v2_findings.name: Host namespace is not bound to the pending lifetime
existing_limitations_not_new_v2_findings.source: ipc.js:67-72 uses only the sessionState object for lifetime namespace; ipc.js:105 sends the retained request to the latest discovery URL. The new UI Map uses projectId only.
existing_limitations_not_new_v2_findings.observed: Independent synthetic test obtains ACK from host A, changes discovery to host B with different host_instance_id/data_dir while retaining sessionState, then repeats the payload: the identical original envelope reaches B and completes. This shell behavior predates this v2 repair and is reported as an existing integration limitation, not as a newly introduced regression.
existing_limitations_not_new_v2_findings.scope_limit: Synthetic dependency-boundary reproduction only; no actual native bootstrap, user data directory switch or Electron host replacement was performed.
